rationale: PINS the SCD12 gap (M37 #598): Scala 3 given definitions reference the type they PROVIDE. `given Ordering[Int] with {}` previously emitted ZERO type references — the given's type clause (generic_type/type_identifier child) was never walked by collectDeclaredTypeRefs, so the contextual-abstraction graph was invisible. The provided type (Ordering/Codec) and its type arguments (Int) must both emit given_type refs sourced to the enclosing declaration; the given's own name (intCodec) is the named identifier child, not a type.
